historic_survey.note: Recorded under the name Hal Metzel the Auto Tailor auto upholstery shop.

historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as an auto repair shop. Built with wooden mezzanine windows divided into many lights.
After earlier use as an auto repair shop, an automobile upholstery business has worked here since 1938.
Listed in the city directory as Hal Metzel Auto Seat Covers, Hal Van Products, wholesale seat covers.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register, under Criterion 1.

unknowns.vnar-42-twelfth-st-construction: The survey dates this building to 1919; the assessor's 2025 roll gives the parcel a year built of 1916. Recorded, not reconciled.
